title.en: An Act to Reorganize the Districts of Bongabong and Puerto Galera, Province of Mindoro, as Municipalities.

text.en:
The districts of Bongabong and Puerto Galera, Province of Mindoro, are hereby organized as
municipalities, with their present territory.

The municipal officers who upon the approval of this Act are at the head of said districts shall
continue to hold office until their successors shall have been duly elected and qualified in the election of
nineteen hundred and twenty-eight.

The salaries of the municipal officers of Bongabong and Puerto Galera shall not be in excess of
the maximum established by law for the class of municipalities to which they belong.

Hereafter all the provisions of the Municipal Law and Provincial Law shall be applicable to the
municipalities organized under this Act.
All acts and provisions of law inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1927.
